name: duplicate-marking
description: Identify and flag PCR and optical duplicate reads that arise from library amplification and sequencing artifacts. Use Picard MarkDuplicates or samtools markdup. For optical duplicates on patterned flow cells (HiSeq 4000, NovaSeq 6000), set OPTICAL_DUPLICATE_PIXEL_DISTANCE to 2500 (default 100 is for unpatterned). PCR-free libraries still require duplicate marking for optical duplicates.
